title: Workspace items
caption: Items in the financial workspace: three pipelines, the notebooks and the warehouse.
alt: Workspace item list with two paginated reports, a dashboard marked Unsupported for Git, a Dataflow Gen2 item, three pipelines, notebooks, a warehouse, lakehouses, a report and a semantic model. The status bar shows a development branch.

title: Warehouse gold tables
caption: Gold tables in the warehouse, including the control tables.
alt: Warehouse explorer, gold schema, Tables: dimension, fact and template tables, two control tables for the gold watermark and the pipeline run log, and two staging tables.

title: Warehouse stored procedures
caption: The gold stored procedures, including the two incremental ones.
alt: Warehouse explorer, gold schema, Stored Procedures: two incremental procedures for invoices and sales and a set of load procedures for dimensions and facts.

title: Warehouse views
caption: The gold views over the warehouse tables.
alt: Warehouse explorer, gold schema, Views: a list of views for the dimensions, facts and templates.

title: Daily pipeline canvas
caption: The daily pipeline: five working steps, then a success log, or a skip-and-fail log followed by a Fail step.
alt: Pipeline canvas: five working steps in a row (a notebook named Bronze, a notebook named silver, two stored procedures for sales and invoices, and a notebook named SemanticModel). From the last notebook, one line leads to a Log_success script and a failure path leads to a Log_Skip-fail script, which leads to a Fail activity. Green arrows join the steps. The profile picture and trial banner are covered.

title: Gold sales procedure step
caption: Step 3 runs the incremental sales procedure in the warehouse.
alt: Pipeline canvas with the gold sales stored procedure step selected and its Settings tab open. A warehouse connection and database are set, the procedure is [gold].[sp_IncrementalFactSales], and the parameters list is empty.

title: Gold invoices procedure step
caption: Step 4 runs the incremental invoices procedure after sales.
alt: Pipeline canvas with the gold invoices stored procedure step selected and its Settings tab open. A warehouse connection and database are set, the procedure is [gold].[sp_IncrementalFactInvoices], and the parameters list is empty.

title: Model refresh step
caption: Step 5 runs the model refresh notebook.
alt: Pipeline canvas with the SemanticModel notebook step selected and its Settings tab open. The connection is empty, the workspace field is blurred, and the notebook is NB_Model_Refresh. A success line and a failure line leave the step.

title: Success log step
caption: The success path writes a Succeeded row to the run log.
alt: Pipeline canvas with the Log_success script step selected and its Settings tab open. The script inserts a row into the gold pipeline run log table with the status Succeeded, an empty message and a timestamp. The run id is a dynamic value.

title: Failure log step
caption: The failure path writes a Failed row to the run log.
alt: Pipeline canvas with the Log_Skip-fail script step selected and its Settings tab open. The script is a query that inserts a row into the gold pipeline run log table with the status Failed, a message that a step failed or was skipped, and a timestamp. The run id is a dynamic value.

title: Fail step
caption: The Fail step ends a failed run with error code 500, so the run still shows as failed.
alt: Pipeline canvas with the Fail activity selected and its Settings tab open. The fail message field is cut off at the left and error code 500 is set.
